caption: The drawing depicts a black top hat with a wide brim and a slightly curved crown, featuring a red and yellow border around the brim. The hat has a decorative band with a red ribbon design and gold trim, displaying the large yellow text "FRANKLIN" at the top and "HOSE" at the bottom. In the center of the band, inside an oval frame with gold laurel leaves, is a portrait of a man with a bald head, white hair at the sides, and dressed in a brown coat with a white cravat. The top of the hat shows a large gold star shape. The drawing is set against a plain beige background with scattered areas of discoloration or stains.
title: Fireman's Hat
